chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. chapters.title: Iteration 18: The Generative Assault and the First Numerics — Four Constructions Fail, No Zero-Mode, No Flip
chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. The user-demanded attempt to devise the generative step: four construction angles all fail (both referees FLIP_REFUTED), and the first numerical computation in the project (the free massive scalar double-cone modular spectrum) finds no zero-mode, supporting (E_O). The verdict stands a seventeenth time.

chapters.title: Iteration 19: Proving the Numerics — The E=0 Half Becomes a Theorem; the Residual Sharpened to One Question
chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. The analytic follow-through: LEM-K0 refereed confirmed (the E=0 half of free-field (E_O) established, with the Figliolini-Guido 1989 primary source verified and the iteration-17 unverified tag retired); the lambda != 1 exclusion isolated as the entire remaining free-field residual with a named single-mechanism best-lead; the pinning scan finds no embedded eigenvalue. The verdict stands an eighteenth time.

chapters.title: Iteration 20: The Antilocality Extension — The Gate Becomes a Bilateral-Antilocality Statement; LEM-A1' Minted
chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. The iteration-19 best-lead attacked head-on with post-1989 fractional unique-continuation theory, an explicit virial computation, and truncated Wiener-Hopf spectral theory: the eigenvalue question becomes exactly a bilateral-antilocality statement with coupling c > 1 (FG-1989 the degenerate boundary case); two new unconditional rigidity theorems; a proved no-soft-theorem obstruction; the missing lemma weakens to the corner problem LEM-A1' — checkable by a fractional-UCP specialist, whose proof fires R7 -> R8. The verdict stands a nineteenth time.

chapters.title: Iteration 21: The LEM-A1' Attempt — The Corner Indicial Theorem, the Strip Geometrization, and the c-Collapse
chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. The direct proof attempt: the Corner Indicial Theorem lands (cos^2(pi s) = c; tau_0 = eps/2pi exactly — Bisognano-Wichmann recovered from a corner computation; lattice-verified); the strip geometrization with closed-form potential and the Krein-symmetrizer no-go; and the c-collapse — the entire free-field gate becomes one spectral question (LEM-A1'') about one explicitly-constructed self-adjoint operator, the very operator the project's numerics diagonalize. No complete proof assembles; the verdict stands a twentieth time.

chapters.title: Iteration 22: The Mourre-Feshbach Execution — The BIC Methods-No-Go, the Conditional Theorem, and LEM-A1'''
chapters.trim: Drop YAML frontmatter and 'See also' block. Both routes to LEM-A1'' executed: the Gaussian rank-one BIC counterexample proves no decay/analyticity-class theorem can close the gate (a second strategy-boundary after BKT); the conditional Mourre theorem lands with an explicit conjugate operator; the residue compresses to LEM-A1''' — one crux (on-shell nondegeneracy through the potential's structural origin) plus three prerequisites, one a single unperformed finite determinant. The verdict stands a twenty-first time. The closing chapter of the research arc.
